subject: Cyprium Capital: Technical Vulnerability Questionnaire — Redwood responses
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cypriumcap.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priya.sharma@cypriumcap.com
Date: Wed, Apr 28 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Cyprium technical questionnaire: vuln management + SBOM request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement for the Cyprium Platform integration we kicked off a short security questionnaire focused on vulnerability management. Can you provide responses and artifacts for the following items by EOD Friday: 

1) SAST/DAST: which tools you run (internal vs third-party), scan cadence, and how results are triaged.
2) Pen test summary: last three penetration tests (date, scope, critical/ high findings and mitigation status).
3) Patch SLA: timeline commitments for critical/ high/ medium/ low, and any exception process.
4) SBOM: format(s) you can provide and whether you can provide per-release SBOMs for hosted deployments.
5) Evidence: any supporting artifacts (sample SBOM, pen test exec summary, patch SLAs table).

We have a standard template but happy to accept consolidated attachments. Priya (cc) is handling vendor intake.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Security Engineer, Cyprium Capital
alex.johnson@cypriumcap.com
(415) 555-0192

From: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cypriumcap.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, priya.sharma@cypriumcap.com
Date: Thu, Apr 29 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cyprium technical questionnaire: vuln management + SBOM request

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a consolidated package and a short answers doc + attachments. High-level plan:

- Deliverable set (by EOD Friday 2027-04-30): consolidated Q&A PDF, sample SBOM (CSV), pen test executive summary (PDF), and our patch SLA table (CSV).
- Contacts: Marissa Cole (AppSec lead) will own pen-test and triage details; Jonas Weber (Platform Security) will handle SBOM and patch SLA specifics.

Below are brief answers; the attachments will have full detail. If you prefer the original template populated, we can do that as a follow-up.

1) SAST/DAST
- Tools: SAST: internal pipeline plus Synk (SCA) and Semgrep for custom rules. DAST: periodic dynamic scans with third-party provider (RunSafe) for our hosted control plane and smoke DAST during major releases.
- Cadence: SAST runs on every PR (pre-merge) and nightly full-stack scans; DAST runs weekly for critical public endpoints and nightly in canary environments during major releases.
- Triage: Findings are auto-filed into Jira (severity mapped to critical/high/medium/low), with SLA-driven queues (see patch SLA csv). Remediation owners are assigned within 24 hours for critical items.

2) Pen tests
- Last full external pen test: 2027-03-10 (external vendor: RedFort Security) — scope: hosted API, authentication, multi-tenant data isolation; Findings: 0 critical, 2 high (fixed), 5 medium (in progress).
- Prior: 2026-09-14 (internal + vendor joint engagement) — 1 critical (container misconfig) mitigated immediately.
- Summaries included in attachment pen_test_summary_q1_2027.pdf.

3) Patch SLA (summary)
- Critical: remediation or mitigations within 72 hours; Hotfixes deployed within 7 calendar days where safe.
- High: mitigations within 7 days; full remediation within 30 days.
- Medium: remediation within 90 days depending on risk and exploitability.
- Low: tracked per release backlog.
- Exceptions: formal exception process documented; temporary compensating controls may be applied with approval from Platform Security. Full table in attachment patch_sla_table.csv.

4) SBOM
- Formats: SPDX and CycloneDX; we can export per-release SBOMs for our hosted and dedicated offerings. Attached sample: redwood_sbom_20270430.csv (exported from CycloneDX compatible tool).
- Frequency: SBOM generated at build time per release, and available on request for a given release tag. For Private deployments, per-release SBOM generation is part of the delivery package.

5) Evidence & artifacts
- Attached: pen_test_summary_q1_2027.pdf (exec summary), redwood_sbom_20270430.csv (sample), patch_sla_table.csv (SLA mapping).

If you have a short checklist in your intake template that we should populate instead, let us know and we will return it filled.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cypriumcap.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priya.sharma@cypriumcap.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, Apr 30 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cyprium technical questionnaire: vuln management + SBOM request

Tessa / Marissa / Jonas — appreciate the quick turnaround. Couple follow-ups after an initial skim:

- For the 2027-03-10 pen test: can you clarify whether the two "high" findings were code-level or infra-level, and confirm remediation dates? We need a simple table for our legal team.
- For patch SLA: when you say "Hotfixes deployed within 7 calendar days where safe" — can you confirm whether your customers are notified in advance and whether you offer emergency maintenance windows?
- SBOM: the sample CSV is useful — can you also provide a CycloneDX JSON for one of the last three releases? Our automation ingests JSON.

If it's easier, a one-page addendum answering those three bullets would be perfect.

Best,
Alex
From: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cypriumcap.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, priya.sharma@cypriumcap.com
Date: Fri, Apr 30 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cyprium technical questionnaire: vuln management + SBOM request

Alex — thanks for the clarifying questions. Quick addendum below; attached is a one-page table and a CycloneDX sample export for release v2027.03.

1) 2027-03-10 pen test high findings (summary table attached) - Finding A (high) — auth session fixation vector affecting legacy token path (code-level). Remediated: 2027-03-18 (patch applied to hosted API and backported to maintained major minor). Verification: retest by vendor completed 2027-03-22.
- Finding B (high) — insufficient network ACL on a non-prod subnet that allowed cross-tenant reachability in a narrow window (infra-level). Remediated: 2027-03-12 with network rule changes and improved automation; verification completed 2027-03-16.

2) Patch SLA / emergency maintenance - Customer notifications: Yes — for planned hotfixes and emergency maintenance customers receive an email and Console banner at least 1 hour prior for emergency windows and 72 hours for scheduled maintenance.
- Emergency maintenance: we support immediate emergency windows for critical outages; we follow an incident comms playbook (timeline and rollback plan). Customers on Dedicated contracts can define extended notification SLAs in their agreement.

3) SBOM JSON
- Attached: cyclone_v2027_03.json (sample CycloneDX JSON for release v2027.03). If you prefer a signed checksum or automated S3 location, we can provision access scoped to Cyprium.

Next steps: I attached a one-page addendum (cyprium_addendum_20270430.pdf) that summarizes the above and includes the pen test mini-table and a link to the CycloneDX JSON. Please confirm if this satisfies legal intake or if you want the answers inserted into your original template.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 30-min call if useful.

Best,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
